\1 It is advised that the influent and effluent samples are collected considering flow detention time through each plant. Analytical
MQLs should be used so that the data can also be used for Local Limits assessment and NPDES application purposes.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Interpreting 'it is advised' and 'should be used' as binding versus advisory affects whether sampling timing and MQL selection are required monitoring conditions (B), whether reported values are usable for numeric limit comparison (A), and whether absent or non-MQL data is treated as unresolved missing evidence versus an established no-comparison state (C).

candidates.computation_change_reason: The 'only complete for pollutants that have approved Technically Based Local Limits' qualifier gates whether a headworks loading numeric limit is applicable at all; different interpretations of which pollutants qualify change which enforceable limits are selected and compared.

candidates.computation_change_reason: This footnote defines an alternative limit source (permit daily average versus WQS-equivalent effluent limit); interpreting which branch applies, or how 'calculated to an equivalent permit effluent limit' is performed, changes the numeric limit used for exceedance determination.
